meta.name: logo-design
meta.description: Professional logo and brand-mark design, from brief to production files. Guides discovery and the design brief, concept generation, choosing a mark type (wordmark, monogram, letterform, pictorial, abstract, emblem, mascot, combination), building clean geometric SVG logos, optical refinement, colour and typography, testing (16 px, one-colour, reversed, shelf test), client presentation, delivery variants and brand guidelines. Includes a searchable library of 1,400+ real-world SVG logos classified by type, technique, geometry and industry, plus scripts that audit SVGs and generate test sheets, presentation boards and export variants. Use this skill whenever the user wants a logo, logotype, wordmark, monogram, brand mark, symbol, app icon or favicon designed, redesigned, refreshed, critiqued or compared; asks for logo ideas or concepts; needs a design brief, logo guidelines, lockups or an identity system; or mentions branding a new company, product, app or project — even if they don't say the word "logo".

copy.tagline: 把模糊的品牌构想落成可用的 Logo 与品牌规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正为新公司、产品或 App 做品牌,需要一套能落地的 Logo 方案
copy.tagline_en: Turn a brand brief into production-ready logos and brand guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're branding a new company, product or app and need a real logo system

howto.what: Claude 会以资深品牌设计师的方式工作：先梳理一份简短简报，产出多个概念并用 SVG 绘制，做小尺寸、单色等测试，再按你选定的方向出配色、锁定组合、favicon 与使用规范。
howto.when: 当你想为新公司、产品或 App 设计、重做或评审 logo（标志、图标等）时触发，即使你没说出「logo」二字。

say.text: 帮我给新咖啡店设计一个 logo
say.note: 它会先问品牌信息再出概念

say.text: 看看我这个 logo，指出问题
把选定的 logo 导出 favicon 和 app 图标

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior identity designer: gathers a brief, drafts concepts, draws them as SVG, tests small sizes and one-colour versions, then builds colour, lockups, favicons and usage guidelines for the direction you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a logo, logotype, mark or icon designed, redesigned, critiqued or compared for a new company, product or app — even if you never say the word "logo".

say_en.text: Design a logo for my new coffee shop
say_en.note: It asks about the brand first

say_en.text: Take a look at my logo and tell me what's wrong
